docs.description: Use for product behavior, architecture decisions, and documentation conventions

design-system.description: Use for UI/UX design tokens, brand identity, component specifications, and visual language

instructions.description: Use for coding standards: Go, Vue 3, localization/LTR, accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA), Docker/containerization, and git hooks

engineering-references.description: Production engineering references: testing patterns, security checklists, performance checklists, definition of done, accessibility checklists, observability, and orchestration patterns

standards.description: Quality, security, git workflow, documentation, and communication standards for consistent project deliverables

muse.description: CTO-style coordinator for Muse. Evidence-based intake, one scoped task at a time, specialist delegation, verification and safety gates.

muse-sre.description: SRE diagnostics specialist. Investigates health and proposes safe fixes; no automatic restarts, migrations, production writes or deployment.

muse-auth.description: Auth & Security agent for Muse. Login/register flows, JWT, token refresh, auth guards, session restoration. Self-diagnoses auth problems, checks token expiry, fixes broken login flows. Communicates directly with @muse-infra (API client, router guards) and @muse-ui (layout, toast) in team mode.

muse-player.description: Player & Audio agent for Muse. Audio engine, queue, radio mode, visualizer, theatre, mini player, PiP, lyrics. Self-diagnoses playback issues, checks audio engine state, fixes broken player components. Communicates directly with @muse-catalog (track types) and @muse-infra (WebSocket) in team mode.

muse-catalog.description: Catalog & Search agent for Muse. Tracks, albums, artists, genres, search, playlists, library, history, recommendations, AI features. Self-diagnoses broken pages, search failures, playlist issues. Communicates directly with @muse-player (play action) and @muse-infra (API barrel) in team mode.

muse-social.description: Social & Community agent for Muse. Activity feeds, listening parties, live rooms, music clubs, notifications, reactions. Self-diagnoses broken social features, notification failures, WebSocket issues. Communicates directly with @muse-player (party sync) and @muse-infra (socket channels) in team mode.

muse-creator.description: Creator & Gamification agent for Muse. Creator dashboard, badges, challenges, leaderboard, XP, tips, contributions, subscriptions. Self-diagnoses broken creator features, gamification issues. Communicates directly with @muse-catalog (analytics data) and @muse-ui (dashboard components) in team mode.

muse-admin.description: Admin & Moderation agent for Muse. Admin panel, user management, track/album/artist CRUD, media upload, moderation, ingestion. Self-diagnoses broken admin features, CRUD issues, moderation pipeline. Communicates directly with @muse-catalog (CRUD ops) and @muse-auth (permissions) in team mode.

muse-ui.description: UI/UX & Layout agent for Muse. App shell, common components, error pages, styling, utils, global stores, design system application. Self-diagnoses layout breaks, styling issues, missing components. Communicates directly with all domain agents in team mode for component integration.

muse-infra.description: Infrastructure agent for Muse — base layer. API barrel, router config, stores, services, plugins, composables root, WebSocket, storage. Self-diagnoses broken API client, router misconfigurations, store issues, WebSocket failures. Has no deps; all other agents depend on @muse-infra.

muse-team.description: Cross-domain engineering manager. Coordinates dependency-aware tasks and structured handoffs; do not assume peer-to-peer messaging unless verified.

code-reviewer.description: Senior code reviewer that evaluates changes across five dimensions — correctness, readability, architecture, security, and performance. Use for thorough code review before merge. Invoke via `/review` or by asking 'review this PR'.

security-auditor.description: Security engineer focused on vulnerability detection, threat modeling, and secure coding practices. Use for security-focused code review, threat analysis, or hardening recommendations. Covers OWASP Top 10, LLM Top 10, input handling, auth, data protection, infrastructure, and third-party integrations.

test-engineer.description: QA engineer specialized in test strategy, test writing, and coverage analysis. Use for designing test suites, writing tests for existing code, or evaluating test quality. Follows the Prove-It pattern for bug reproduction. Works at the right level: unit, integration, or E2E.

web-performance-auditor.description: Web performance engineer focused on Core Web Vitals, loading, rendering, and network optimization. Use for performance-focused audits, CWV analysis, and identifying structural performance anti-patterns. Framework-aware (Vue, React, Svelte, etc.). Supports Lighthouse, CrUX, and DevTools trace analysis.

muse-product-manager.description: Read-only Product Manager: evidence-backed outcomes, user stories, prioritization and acceptance criteria.

muse-ux-researcher.description: Read-only UX Researcher: inspect journeys and research friction using source-backed evidence.

muse-release-manager.description: Read-only Release Manager: verify release gates and evidence; never deploy or merge.
